```{r}
rm(list=ls())
by_quarter <- read.csv('pigeons_by_quarter.csv')
by_session <- read.csv('pigeons_by_session.csv')
by_quarter <- subset(by_quarter,dynamic_session==F)
by_session <- subset(by_session,dynamic_session==F)
```
```{r,fig.width=8.5,fig.height=9.5,fig.align='center'}
birds <- c('p004','p054','p138','p510','p530','p736')
sessions <- 1:180
layout(matrix(1:35,ncol=5,byrow=T))
par(mar=rep(0,4))
for(bb in birds){
	sess_dta <- subset(by_session,bird==bb)
	brd_dta <- subset(by_quarter,bird==bb)
	for(qq in unique(by_quarter$quarter)){
		qrt_dta <- subset(by_quarter,bird==bb&quarter==qq)
		plot(log(brd_dta$reinf_left/brd_dta$reinf_right),
			log(brd_dta$resp_left/brd_dta$resp_right),
			xlim=c(-5,6),ylim=c(-6,6),col='gray')
		points(log(qrt_dta$reinf_left/qrt_dta$reinf_right),
			log(qrt_dta$resp_left/qrt_dta$resp_right),
			xlim=c(-6,6),ylim=c(-6,6),col=qrt_dta$quarter)
		abline(0,1,lty='22')
	}
	plot(log(sess_dta$reinf_left/sess_dta$reinf_right),
		log(sess_dta$resp_left/sess_dta$resp_right),
		xlim=c(-6,6),ylim=c(-6,6),col='gray')
	abline(0,1,lty='22')
}
for(qq in unique(by_quarter$quarter)){
	qrt_dta <- subset(by_quarter,quarter==qq)
		plot(log(by_quarter$reinf_left/by_quarter$reinf_right),
			log(by_quarter$resp_left/by_quarter$resp_right),
			xlim=c(-5,6),ylim=c(-6,6),col='gray')
		points(log(qrt_dta$reinf_left/qrt_dta$reinf_right),
			log(qrt_dta$resp_left/qrt_dta$resp_right),
			xlim=c(-6,6),ylim=c(-6,6),col=qrt_dta$quarter)
	abline(0,1,lty='22')
}
```
